name: BRAND Name Championship
epitaph: BRAND Wrestling's own top title. Its champs.php page, the only surviving record of its lineage, names SHARC as champion with no history behind the belt — the title-history pages for all three of the fed's championships pulled from a news database this deposit does not carry.
notes: champs.php, the site's own current-champions page; its own bnc.php title-history page renders nothing beyond a pulled-and-uncaptured news feed.

name: Mountain Dew Championship
